fields.description: How often alfaEdge Pulse itself checks the current heartbeat of each site from every enabled Uptime Kuma Instance's /metrics endpoint — genuinely down to a few seconds, not just once a minute (it runs its own loop, not a cron tick). Takes effect within one poll cycle of saving, no restart needed. Purely about how often *we* read a result — see Heartbeat Interval below for how often *Kuma itself* actually checks.
fields.label: Poll Interval (seconds)

fields.description: A site is flagged Critical once more than half of its last N checks report Down. A single check reporting Up resets the majority the moment it tips back below 50%.
fields.label: Alert Window (checks)

fields.description: How often Kuma itself actually checks each site — same field as "Heartbeat Interval" in Kuma's own monitor editor. Separate from Poll Interval above on purpose: this is what Kuma uses to decide Up/Down, that's just how often we read the result. Changing this pushes the new interval onto every Uptime Site, both here and on Kuma itself (a live edit call per site) — see "Sync Check Interval Now".
fields.label: Heartbeat Interval (seconds)

fields.description: Re-pushes the Heartbeat Interval above onto every Uptime Site (locally and on Kuma) — runs automatically whenever Heartbeat Interval changes, so this is only needed to force an immediate re-check.
fields.label: Sync Check Interval Now

fields.description: Keeps every enabled instance in sync with the fleet: pulls in monitors that already exist on an instance's Kuma but aren't tracked here yet (e.g. one added directly in Kuma), and pushes sites that already exist on other instances onto one that's missing them (e.g. a newly connected instance). Turn off to only add/sync sites via "Add Site" or a manual "Import Existing Monitors" pass.
fields.label: Keep Instances In Sync

fields.description: How often each instance is checked for monitors not yet tracked here. Runs less often than polling since it needs a Socket.IO login, not just an HTTP GET.
fields.label: Auto-Import Interval (minutes)

fields.description: Uptime Check Log rows older than this are purged daily. Alerting only ever looks at the last few checks (Alert Window above), so this is purely about keeping the table from growing forever — history views/charts beyond this window won't have data to show.
fields.label: Check Log Retention (days)
